findings.summary: PR was CONFLICTING on GitHub after #409 merged (GitHub's server-side merge ignores .gitattributes merge=union on .vfkb/entries.jsonl), contradicting the PR body's 'can merge independently'. Fixed by merging origin/main into the branch (union merge local, 699 JSONL lines all parse; 1193/1193 serial at the merge head).
Doc drift: kb_supersede's tags param description (src/mcp-server.ts:276) and README.md:178 do not mention that omitted tags are now inherited from the predecessor, or that CLI supersede takes --tag.

No CLI route to an untagged successor of a tagged predecessor (flagList rejects --tag '' and ',,,'); MCP can only do it via tags='[]' (tags() returns [] for an empty JSON array but undefined for ''). Consistent with decision 35c0d9b23224 ('explicit tags override inheritance'); noted, not blocking.

ruledOut: call sites: grep -rn 'supersede(' src/ -> only src/cli.ts:607 and src/mcp-server.ts:281 call engine supersede(); curator.ts only references it in an error string. Both faces get the inheritance.
MCP absent/empty tags: tags() returns undefined for undefined and for '' / whitespace (src/mcp-server.ts:83-85), so the engine's ?? inherits; no MCP regression.
CLI empty list: --tag '' errors (exit 1, non-empty list message); bare --tag errors 'requires a value' -- probed against dist/cli.js.
predecessor with no tags: old.tags undefined -> successor tags undefined, same as before.
no merge semantics: explicit tags replace (verified by mutation M4).
